prose: Health Hero Tim James had me on his podcast to discuss ether and the science of using sound to balance the human biofield.

From Tim's description: After being a guest on Chance’s podcast I learned that he was into sound healing and frequency medicine. Over the last 11 years during my health journey, I have had my mind opened by witnessing the healing power of these types of modalities personally and with others. I was very excited to get him on the show to learn from him so I booked a sound healing session with him and then had him on the show. During this conversation, everything clicked for me and now I have a deeper understanding of “why” frequency medicine works so well and I am hoping that this episode will do the same for you. So, bring an open mind and an open heart and listen to this amazing interview with Chance Garton, a true sound healing expert. Love & Light, Coach Tim.
